author: Google
description:
Your favorite Search just got even more helpful with Personal Intelligence in AI Mode. By tapping into your context from Gmail and Photos, it delivers tailored responses and unique recommendations based on who you are and what you love.

It’s a powerful new way to search, and because it's an opt-in experience, it remains all under your control.

At launch, Personal Intelligence in AI Mode will only be available to Google One Pro and Ultra subscribers in Labs. (US only)

author: Google
description:
Meet Personal Intelligence in AI Mode in Search. Now, you can securely connect Search to Google apps like Gmail and Google Photos to get responses that are uniquely relevant to you. 

Here’s VP of Product for Google Search, Robby Stein, on how this makes Search even more helpful.

(The ability to connect AI Mode to your Gmail and Google Photos is rolling out as a Labs feature. Eligible Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in English in the U.S. will automatically have access to the feature as it becomes available.)

#GoogleSearch
